readerCopy.summary: A creative use of technology makes a distant human reality feel immediate without turning the people living through it into a spectacle.
readerCopy.body: A creative use of technology makes a distant human reality feel immediate without turning the people living through it into a spectacle. Artists, organizers, or mutual-aid networks use new tools to share testimony, route money, and coordinate support while preserving the purpose behind the response. Uranus expands the possible form, while Neptune carries empathy and imagination through it. Under the trine, innovation and collective feeling reinforce each other without allowing the platform to become the entire story. The response reaches farther because the technology remains a bridge instead of replacing the people it was built to serve.
